title: Closing the global menu with the Esc key inappropriately triggers panel auto-hide when the cursor was still hovering over the panel
line: An auto-hide panel no longer hides when you close one of its menus (like the Global Menu) while the pointer is still on it.
explanation: When a menu opened from the panel grabs the pointer, Qt's Wayland plugin sends the panel a Leave event even though the compositor keeps the pointer on the panel. When the menu closes, Qt only sends the matching Enter back to xdg-shell parents, and the panel is a layer-shell surface, so PanelView kept believing the pointer was gone and re-enabled auto-hide as soon as the menu closed. The change makes PanelView ignore that one Leave, the first one after a menu of the panel opens while the pointer is on it; any later Leave (the pointer really leaving the panel or moving into the menu) is handled as before.

commits.message:
shell/panelview: Ignore the Leave event sent when a popup opens

Qt sends the panel a Leave when one of its menus grabs the pointer, and no
Enter once it closes, so closing the Global Menu with Esc hid an auto-hide
panel still under the pointer. Ignore that one Leave while the menu is up.

BUG: 473454

media.caption: Master, top auto-hide panel: File open from the Global Menu (top), then 0.6 s after pressing Esc with the pointer still on File (bottom): the panel is gone.
Patched: same steps, the panel stays under the pointer after Esc (it hides once the pointer leaves it).
Master: closing the menu by clicking File again hides the panel under the pointer.
Patched: clicking File again closes the menu and the panel stays.

review.text: The cause is in Qt's Wayland plugin (Leave sent on popup grab, matching Enter only re-sent to xdg-shell parents), and the notes say a qtbase patch already exists as the cleaner fix; PanelView now swallows a Leave based on a broad heuristic. The `!parent || !parent->isVisible()` branch matches any parentless visible popup in plasmashell, so with several auto-hide panels or a desktop menu open a real Leave on another panel could be dropped, leaving m_containsMouse stuck true until the pointer re-enters.
changes: Submit the existing qtbase fix (fixdb-prev/473454/qtbase-fix.patch) upstream to Qt and reference the Qt bug/change in the comment.

If a Plasma workaround is kept until Qt is fixed, guard it by Qt version and narrow the parentless-popup match (e.g. only popups whose input/transient origin is this panel, or whose geometry is adjacent to it) so real Leaves on other panels are not ignored.
